Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

We acknowledge your renewal offer and stated cost context, as well as your price freeze and management approval requirements. We propose focusing the renewal on a longer contract term, extended payment terms and greater call-off flexibility within your delegated approval authority.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 4,580 units per year for 36 months, 13,740 units in total.
2. Our proposal: option A: EUR 425.71 per unit, 60 days net, 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year; option B: EUR 424.29 per unit, 45 days net, 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year; option C: EUR 422.87 per unit, 30 days net, 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year. Option A amounts to about EUR 5,849,255 over the term.
3. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of one option we will issue the order.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your proposal and the provided call-off schedule for a 36-month contract term. 

Please be advised that our base prices are currently frozen; however, the extended 36-month commitment enables us to offer a revised price of €430.15 per unit, maintaining the 30 days net payment term. 

Alternatively, our current Angebot stands at a price of €431.61 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. 

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to? 

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
